name: transfer_to_agent
description: transfer_to_agent: Transfer the call to a live human agent. Use when the caller explicitly requests a live agent, when the issue cannot be resolved, or when a situation exceeds the automated agent's authority.

transfer_reason.description: The reason for transferring the call.

issue_summary.description: A brief summary of the request, what was attempted, and why transfer is needed, so the live agent has full context. This should be in the same language as the conversation you had with the user.
